businessAssertions.name: Severity seed data has four active levels
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 4 from severity_levels where is_active = true

businessAssertions.name: Priority seed data has four active levels
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 4 from priority_levels where is_active = true

businessAssertions.name: Active project operational defect count excludes inactive projects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 4 from defects d join projects p on p.id = d.project_id where p.is_active = true and d.is_deleted = false

businessAssertions.name: Inactive project defects are retained for audit/history
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) >= 1 from defects d join projects p on p.id = d.project_id where p.is_active = false

businessAssertions.name: Test context returns only active Test environment defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 3 from defects d join projects p on p.id = d.project_id join environments e on e.id = d.environment_id where p.is_active = true and d.is_deleted = false and e.environment_scope = 'Test'

businessAssertions.name: Prod context returns only active Prod environment defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 1 from defects d join projects p on p.id = d.project_id join environments e on e.id = d.environment_id where p.is_active = true and d.is_deleted = false and e.environment_scope = 'Prod'

businessAssertions.name: InProgress allows Fixed and Rejected only
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(to_status in ('Fixed', 'Rejected')) from workflow_transitions wt join workflow_definitions wd on wd.id = wt.workflow_definition_id where wd.is_active = true and wt.is_active = true and wt.from_status = 'InProgress'

businessAssertions.name: Rejected has no allowed next status
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 0 from workflow_transitions wt join workflow_definitions wd on wd.id = wt.workflow_definition_id where wd.is_active = true and wt.is_active = true and wt.from_status = 'Rejected'

businessAssertions.name: Defects do not use statuses outside active workflow status set
businessAssertions.sql: with active_statuses as (select from_status as status from workflow_transitions wt join workflow_definitions wd on wd.id = wt.workflow_definition_id where wd.is_active = true and wt.is_active = true union select to_status from workflow_transitions wt join workflow_definitions wd on wd.id = wt.workflow_definition_id where wd.is_active = true and wt.is_active = true) select count(*) = 0 from defects d where d.current_status not in (select status from active_statuses)

businessAssertions.name: Release rollout contents are derived from defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) >= 2 from defects where fixed_in_release_id is not null

businessAssertions.name: Inline assets link to existing defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 0 from defect_inline_assets ia left join defects d on d.id = ia.defect_id where d.id is null

businessAssertions.name: Attachments link to existing defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 0 from defect_attachments da left join defects d on d.id = da.defect_id where d.id is null

businessAssertions.name: Comments link to existing defects
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 0 from defect_comments dc left join defects d on d.id = dc.defect_id where d.id is null

businessAssertions.name: History events have event batch IDs
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) = 0 from defect_history_events where event_batch_id is null

businessAssertions.name: One seeded save action groups multiple history rows
businessAssertions.sql: select count(*) >= 1 from (select event_batch_id from defect_history_events group by event_batch_id having count(*) > 1) grouped_events
